# Compliance Inventory (auto-generated)

Generated by `scripts/compliance-inventory.py` on 2026-10-17.

This is the canonical manifest of every git-tracked file in NereusSDR,
classified by upstream lineage into the buckets below:

- `thetis-port` / `aethersdr-port` / `mi0bot-port` — files derived from the named upstream
- `thetis-aethersdr-port` — files with both Thetis and AetherSDR lineage; both sets of header markers are required
- `wdsp-vendored` / `fftw3-vendored` — third-party code vendored verbatim under `third_party/`
- `nereussdr-original` — authored in-house, no upstream lineage
- `attribution-doc` / `docs` / `test` / `packaging` / `resource` — non-source classifications

Regenerate whenever `THETIS-PROVENANCE.md`, `aethersdr-reconciliation.md`,
`WDSP-PROVENANCE.md`, or the source tree changes. Run
`python3 scripts/compliance-inventory.py` and replace only the generated
body beginning at the second `# Compliance Inventory` heading below.
Preserve this metadata and explanation, and update both generated dates. Drift between this
file and the current tree is a CI failure (see Task 15 of
`docs/architecture/2026-04-18-gpl-compliance-full-audit-plan.md`).

The ⚠ flag on an entry means the file's expected license-header markers
were not found in its leading comment block. Flags reflect this marker
check, not a complete licence audit. AetherSDR classification here covers
the genuine-derivation tables in reconciliation Buckets A and C; later
port-registration appendices are outside that parser’s current scope.
New flags on regeneration require investigation.

inventory and per-component provenance docs.
